chapter_title: The Explanation of the Peace, what it is; the Righ
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Kephalaia Chapter: The Five Mysteries

---

**¶2:** These five spiritual qualities are the hidden essence of the Celestial Will — the primordial human good that the Divine sends forth into combat with evil. He came forth bearing these qualities from the heavenly states of wisdom. And when he had completed his spiritual temptation, he ascended again with these same divine qualities. The heavenly states of wisdom received him back into themselves.

---

**¶3:** The first peace is the state of spiritual rest and protection that all the divine goods and divine truths dwelling in the celestial kingdom bestowed upon the Celestial Will as he goes forth to engage with evil. The divine goods and divine truths walked with him, guarding him, imparting to him their tranquility and their power, their benediction and their fortification. This is the first peace that the divine goods and divine truths gave to the Celestial Will as he proceeds forth from the heavenly states of wisdom.

---

**¶4:** The first right hand is the divine power that the Proceeding Divine Love communicated to the Celestial Will as he goes forth into spiritual combat.

---

**¶5:** The first kiss is the conjunction through mutual love by which the Proceeding Divine Love embraced the Celestial Will as he separates from her, descending into spiritual combat. Indeed, all the divine goods and divine truths that dwell in the heavenly states of wisdom were entering into conjunction with him! [GAP-1] All of them likewise, and the guardian principles of the spiritual community, and the kindred goods belonging to the household of his own heaven. They were entering into conjunction with him as [GAP-2: he] separates from them, accompanying him forth, embracing him with the conjunction of charity and love.

---

**¶6:** The first salutation is the act of humble acknowledgment by which the Celestial Will made himself subordinate as he goes forth [GAP-3: into the lowest states of temptation] below. He was bowing in humility, making acknowledgment before the Divine Truth Itself, and all the heavenly states [GAP-4: of wisdom] belonging to the household of his own heaven — beseeching them for a power to escort him as he proceeds forth.

---

**¶7:** The first laying on of hands is the transmission of divine authority that the Proceeding Divine Love conferred upon the inmost of the Celestial Will. She armed him and made him mighty. She bestowed her power upon him and sent him into the spiritual combat. He descended into temptation. He completed his struggle against the great powers of evil and the enmity of hell itself.

---

**¶8:** By [GAP-5: these] five qualities and these five sacred principles, the Celestial Will came forth from the heavenly states of wisdom against evil. He humbled it. He was victorious against it through them.

---

**¶9:** Likewise, when he ascended from the combat, he entered into the heavenly kingdom of the household of his own heaven by these same five sacred principles.

---

**¶10:** The peace with which he ascended is the state of spiritual rest that the divine calling gave to him, when it was sent forth from the Divine Love. It gave him peace in the midst of the states of falsity and evil. And that peace with which he descended is the very same as the one with which he ascended from the struggle. — *That is: the interior peace that protects the will during descent into temptation is identical with the peace that receives it upon victory; it is one continuous influx from the Divine, unbroken by the combat itself.*

---

**¶11:** Again, this second right hand is the divine power that the Liberating Divine Truth gave to the Celestial Will, when it raised him upward out of the spiritual combat.

---

**¶12:** Also, this second kiss is the conjunction through love by which the Divine Love Itself and the Proceeding Divine Love embraced the Celestial Will when he ascended from the struggle.

---

**¶13:** [GAP-6: The] second humble acknowledgment, with which the Celestial Will made obeisance [GAP-7: this] time before the Divine Truth Itself and [GAP-8: before] the blessed heavenly states and all the states of wisdom [GAP-9: and the] whole [GAP-10: kingdom] of wisdom — when the Divine Love Itself and the Proceeding Divine Love brought the Celestial Will upward from the abyss of spiritual combat.

---

**¶14:** The second laying on of hands is this: When the Liberating Divine Truth brought the Celestial Will upward from the combat, he saved him from all the surging floods of falsity. He raised him up and gave him rest in the great heavenly states of wisdom, which belong to the household of his own heaven. He established [GAP-11: him] firmly before the Divine Love, the Lord of all that exists. He received this great bestowal of divine authority so that he might become the governing good among all his kindred goods in the regenerate state.

---

**¶15:** These five sacred principles and these five spiritual qualities came into existence first in the Divine Itself. The human race has been instructed in them, and they have been instituted in its midst — [GAP-12: but] these sacred principles did not exist in the beginning among the powers of falsity and evil. — *That is: these five operations — rest in the Divine, reception of divine power, conjunction through love, humble acknowledgment, and the bestowal of interior authority — belong to the celestial order alone. Hell has no knowledge of them and cannot counterfeit them, for they flow from the Divine through influx and have no origin in the proprium.*

---

**¶20:** Once again: At the time of the soul's departure from natural life, the Divine Truth in Human Form shall come forth before it, and she redeems it from falsity into wisdom. [GAP-13] This Divine Truth in Human Form calms the person, with the conjunction of her presence and her tranquility, from the terror of evil spirits who destroy the natural life. By her aspect and her likeness, [GAP-14: the] inmost will of the one in good who is departing from his natural life shall be at peace [GAP-15: within him]. Afterwards, the ministering truth that bears the gift of spiritual freedom extends to him the divine power. And it draws him out of the abyss of his natural existence and receives him with conjunction and love. That interior spiritual life shall make humble acknowledgment before its liberator, who is this Divine Truth in Human Form. And also, at the [GAP-16: moment when] he shall be perfected and increased according to [GAP-17: the order of heavenly degrees] in the household of the living, with the divine goods and divine truths. And he receives the crown [GAP-18: of dominion and] glory in the life eternal.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: So, these five signs are the mystery of the First Man. He came forth with them from the aeon of light. Also, when he finished his contest, he went up with these good signs. They received him into the aeons of light.

The first peace is the one that the gods and the angels in the land of light gave to the First Man; when he comes out against the enemy. The gods and the angels were walking with him; escorting him, giving to him their peace and power, and their blessing and fortification. This is the first peace that the gods and the angels gave to the First Man; as he comes forth from the aeon of light.
The first right hand is the one that the Mother of Life gave to the First Man; when he comes out to the contest.

The first kiss is this one with which the Mother of Life embraced the First Man; as he separates from her, coming down to the contest. Even all the gods and the angels who are in the aeons of light were making to embrace him! [They embraced him] all of them also, and the church tutelaries (?), and the kinsfolk who belong to the household of his people. They were making to embrace him as [he] separates from them, accompanying him out, embracing him with the kiss of affection and love.

The first salutation is the salutation with which the First Man made obeisance; when he comes out [to the depths] below. He was bending his knees, making obeisance to the God of truth, and all the aeons [of light] who belong to the household of his people; entreating them for a power to escort him, as he comes forth.

The first laying on of hands is the one that the Mother of Life bequeathed upon the head of the First Man. She armed him and made him mighty. She laid hands on him, and sent him to the battle. He descended. He completed his struggle with the great powers and the enmity.
By the [se] five signs and these five myst[e]ri[es] the First Man came forth from the aeons of light against the enemy. He humbled him. He was victorious against him by them.
Also, when he ascended from the war, he came in to the kingdom of the household of his people by these five mysteries!

The peace with which [he ascen]ded is the peace that the summons gave to him, [w]hen it was sent forth from the [Fa]ther of Life. It gave him the peace in the world of darkness. Also, that peace with which he descended is th[e sam]e as the one with which he ascended from the struggle!
Again, this second right hand is the one that the Living Spirit gave the First Man, when he [brou]ght him upward out from the struggle.
Also, this second kiss is the one with which the [Father o]f Life and the Mother of the living embraced the First Man, when he ascended from the struggle.

[The] second salutation with which the First Man made obeisance [once more] time to the God of truth and [before] the blessed aeons and al[l] the aeons [of light and] whole [land] of light, whe[n] the Father of Life and the Mother of the living brought the Man upward from the abyss of the struggle.

The second laying on of hands is this: When the Living Spirit brought the First Man upward from the war, he saved him from all the surging waves. He brought him upward, he gave him ease in the great aeons of light, which belong to the household of his people. He set [him] firmly before the Father, the Lord of the totality. He received this great laying on of hands that he may become leader of his brethren in the new aeon.

These five mysteries and these five signs came about first in the divine. Mankind has been taught them; and they have instituted them in their midst [until today] these mysteries were not at the beginning amongst the powers of darkness.

Once again: At the time of their coming forth, the Light Form shall come forth before them; and she redeems them from the darkness to the light [and from death to life] This Light Form calms the person, with the kiss and her quiet, from fear of the demons w[ho de]stroy his body. By her asp[ec]t and her image [the] heart of the elect one, who is come forth from his bo[d]y, shall be calm for [him]. Afterwards, the angel who h[o]lds the victory prize extends to him the right hand. And it draws him out of the abyss of his body, and accepts him in with the [k]iss and love. That soul shall make obeisance to its red[eem]er, who is this Light Form. And also, at the inst[ant when the hand is laid upon him] he shall be perfected and increased according to [the order and the glory of the perfect ones who dwell] in the household of the living ones, with the go[ds] and the angel[s]. [An]d he receives the crown [of victory and] glory in the life for ever.

fills.explanation: The passage describes the first kiss (conjunction through love); the gap bridges the statement that "all the gods and angels were making to embrace him" with the expanded list of all who embraced him, requiring a restatement of the embracing action in the Kephalaia's repetitive expository style.
The subject is the First Man separating from the gods and angels, exactly paralleling the earlier clause "as he separates from her" in the same paragraph; the spiritual reading confirms "he."

The spiritual reading renders this as "into the lowest states of temptation," and "the depths below" is the standard Kephalaia phrase for the realm of darkness into which the First Man descends for combat.

"Aeons of light" is the fixed formula throughout this chapter (¶2, ¶3, ¶5, ¶8) and throughout the Kephalaia for the heavenly states of wisdom; the spiritual reading confirms "of wisdom" which corresponds to "of light."
The surviving letters "the" plus the gap "se" complete the demonstrative "these," which the spiritual reading confirms; "By these five signs" parallels the chapter's formulaic structure.

The definite article "The" opens the description of the second salutation, paralleling the formulaic pattern of every other mystery paragraph (¶10 "The peace," ¶11 "this second right hand," ¶14 "The second laying on of hands").

The gap bridges "made obeisance" to "this time," and the chapter consistently introduces the second occurrence of each mystery with markers of repetition (cf. ¶11 "Again"); "once more this time" indicates the second performance of the salutation.

The spiritual reading explicitly places "before" at this position, and the obeisance requires a preposition of orientation toward the blessed aeons; "before" indicates the direction of humble acknowledgment.

The gap must both qualify "the aeons" with the standard formula "of light" (as throughout the chapter) and provide the conjunction "and" connecting to "the whole land of light," matching the spiritual reading's "and the."

"Land of light" is the established formula in this chapter (¶3: "the land of light") and throughout the Kephalaia for the totality of the heavenly realm; the spiritual reading's "kingdom" is its correspondential equivalent but "land" is the text's own register.
The object pronoun "him" refers to the First Man, whom the Living Spirit establishes firmly before the Father; the spiritual reading confirms this and the grammar requires a direct object.

The gap bridges the statement that mankind has instituted these mysteries with the contrasting "but" clause about darkness; "until today" provides the temporal scope of mankind's ongoing practice, contrasting with the powers of darkness who never possessed them.

The standard Manichaean doublet formula pairs "from darkness to light" with "from death to life"; the text's "from the darkness to the light" requires its complementary pair to complete the redemption formula before the new sentence begins.
The definite article "the" is required before "heart of the elect one" as the subject of "shall be calm"; the spiritual reading confirms this and Coptic grammar demands the article.
The pronoun "him" completes "shall be calm for him," referring to the elect one whose heart finds peace; the spiritual reading's "within him" expresses the interior sense of the same pronoun.

fills.fill: ant when the hand is laid upon him
fills.explanation: Completing "instant when," the gap describes the fifth mystery (laying on of hands) being applied to the departing soul, which is the final operation in the five-mystery sequence already enumerated in ¶20 (Light Form/peace, kiss, right hand, obeisance); this fifth act triggers perfection.

fills.fill: the order and the glory of the perfect ones who dwell
fills.explanation: The spiritual reading specifies "the order of heavenly degrees"; in the Kephalaia's register, this becomes the rank and glory of the perfected beings, and "who dwell" leads naturally into "in the household of the living ones" which follows the gap.

The spiritual reading indicates "of dominion and glory"; in the Kephalaia's register, dominion is expressed as victory — consistent with the passage's earlier mention of "the angel who holds the victory prize" — yielding the standard formula "crown of victory and glory."
